
# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Context

Cozy Corner is a customizable student dashboard developed as part of the WDD430 – Web Full-Stack Development course.

The application is designed to help students organize their academic activities, manage assignments, take notes, and develop productive study habits.

## Technology Stack

- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS

## General Development Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for application code.
- Avoid using `any`; define explicit types when necessary.
- Prefer functional React components.
- Use reusable components when they provide clear value.
- Follow the existing Next.js App Router conventions.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Keep components focused on a single responsibility.
- Write clear, readable, and maintainable code.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and overengineering.

## Code Quality

- Follow the existing project structure and naming conventions.
- Keep the code consistent with the patterns already established in the project.
- Handle errors appropriately.
- Avoid duplicating code when a reusable solution is practical.
- Do not modify unrelated files when implementing a feature.

## Before Making Changes

- Review the relevant existing files before proposing modifications.
- Understand the current implementation before changing it.
- Explain significant changes when they affect the project structure or behavior.
- Do not assume that a feature is required unless it is part of the project specifications.
